title: Megurine Luka — An Exhilarating Stage!〔Part2〕Side Story (Part 2)

rows.Line: Between Worlds

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line:
I don't see Miku and the others...
Are they checking on the other SEKAI?

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Well, that's only natural.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: We only just had that incident with “us” being sent to different SEKAI, after all.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: That really was startling. Plus...

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: They're not idols, but they sing and perform on stage too!

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: A little while ago, they achieved a dream they've been working toward for a long time. And now, through their singing, they're aiming to stand on top of the world!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Th-The world?! That's amazing...!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Yeah...

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Come to think of it, aren't Haruka and An old friends?

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: When “I” talked about them, An's face may've flashed across her mind.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Speaking of which, I haven't seen that “me” since then.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: I'd like to check in on the tree too, so I think I'll go over there now.
Street SEKAI
Crase Cafe

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line:
There's nobody here...
Not even cafemaster MEIKO.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line:
Are they all out on a trip together?
But this SEKAI doesn't have that many places to visit...

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Huh? Where's that music coming from?

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line:
Also, it sounds very cute and cheerful.
Like an idol doing a concert...

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: This powerful voice! Could it be...?
Plaza

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Yeah♪ Are you all feeling it?

rows.Speaker: An & Rin
rows.Line: Yeah♪

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: I'm not sure that's something an idol would say.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Hehe. I'm sure that some do.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: She's singing and dancing, too...!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: That's amazing! Your footwork and the way you waved your hands was actually cute!

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Now, now. No need to say *actually*.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
I understand what he means, though.
This is completely different from how Luka normally is.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Yeah, she's been going “I can so be an idol!” nonstop lately. And now, she's actually doing it!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: I know I said that I couldn't picture you doing this, Luka, but it might actually suit you really well!

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: She's performing the song and dance that she learned in front of everyone.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line:
We're still just getting started!
I need you all to be even louder!

rows.Speaker: An & Kohane
rows.Line: Okay!

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line:
Yes, that's what I like to hear!
Thanks♪

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Wow!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Did you see that?! She winked for me!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
*Nod*
I'm glad for you.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: All of you over there! I know you can be louder than that! Raise your fists in the air like you just don't care!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Huh? Wait...

rows.Speaker: Rin, KAITO & Len
rows.Line: Yeah!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Do idols usually tell people to clench their fists like that?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: I'm not sure, but as far as gestures go, this one is very easy to understand.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: She's something of a unique idol, perhaps...

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: But...

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line:
Hehe. Everyone's smiling so much.
Not only that...

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line:
She's so dazzling.
Like she's in the spotlight right this second.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: The “me” from this SEKAI really is so free and full of positivity.
